## Rule  — DECODED 2026-06-08 from generator `external/ARC-GEN/tasks/task_e50d258f.py`

> The old "Rule unknown / double-Gather lookup" text below was a description of the OLD LIVE GRAPH, not the rule. The actual ARC rule is now decoded and verified 200k/200k vs ARC-GEN ground truth.

**Generator mapping caveat:** NG task365 → `sorted(training/*.json stems)[364]` → **`e50d258f`**. (A naive `glob *365*` FALSE-matches `task_9b365c51.py` because the UUID contains the literal "365"; that is a DIFFERENT task. Always compute the index mapping.)

**Rule:** The input is a **10×10** grid (`size=10` is fixed) containing **2 or 3 solid axis-aligned rectangles** ("boxes"), each filled with colors from **{1=blue, 8=azure, 2=red}** only (background = 0). Boxes are non-overlapping with a ≥1-cell gap in at least one axis (`common.overlaps(...,spacing=1)`). Each box is sprinkled with a **distinct** number of red(2) cells, the counts drawn descending from {1,2,3,4} via `sorted(common.sample(range(1,5), n), reverse=True)`. **Box 0 — the one with the MOST reds — is the answer.** Output = that box, cropped to its bounding box and placed at the **origin** (top-left), colors preserved verbatim. Output shape = the winning box's (tall × wide), 3..6 in each dim.

So: **find the connected solid rectangle containing the most red cells; emit it at the origin.**

## CURRENT BEST — 2026-07-12: v2 offset-fuse+zero-pad = **2360** (byte-equal to Boladi live 2430)

**The team frontier moved to a DIFFERENT structure than this doc's CumSum-peel line.** Authoritative team-best is now **Boladi 2430** (`ng_current_bar --task 365` live_cost=2430, manifest, sha `7cc43a3da04d98bcaca0e721f8e177bca8453182116387be329a78d9fd980d0d`, updated 2026-07-11). It is **not** a CumSum-peel graph — it is a **corner-detection** graph: `Conv` collapses the one-hot to a weighted color code (`lut_w`: red→128, blue→2, azure→1), `QLinearConv` with kernel `[[0,-1],[-1,4]]` detects box top-left corners, `TopK`-3 on the F16-flattened corner map picks up to 3 corners (`Equal(tv,132)` masks the 2-box case), contiguous-run probes at offsets {3,4,5} read each box's width/height, a **weighted `Einsum('ir,abrc,ic->i', selR, code, selC)`** computes red-count-dominant per-box sums in ONE shot (red weight 128 dominates ≤72 of blue/azure → argmax = most-reds box, no separate red plane), `ArgMax` selects the winner, then `Gather`-crop + `Equal(masked,chconst)` → `[1,8,6,6]` one-hot + `Pad` to `[1,10,30,30]`. This structure invalidates the old "forced CumSum run-detection ≈480 B" floor claim below — Boladi avoids CumSum entirely.

**My win — v2 = 2360, −70 vs live (byte-OUTPUT-identical to Boladi 2430).** Two output-identical byte-layout optimisations on Boladi's parent (proven byte-equal on 2266 corpus pairs + 337 random grids, truth 2000/2000): **(1) offset fusion** — unsqueeze the `[3,1]` corner operand (`left_col4`/`top_col4`, 12 B) *before* the broadcast-add instead of the `[1,1,3,3]` result (`offu_r`/`offu_c`, 36 B each); **(2) zero-pad OOB probe** — corners come from an 8×8 map so probe indices ∈ [3,12]; `Pad` the gathered occupancy 10→13 cols with zeros so OOB reads a structural 0, deleting `Mod`+`Less`+`Where` per side. Memory 2356→2278, params 74→82, **cost 2430→2360**. Staged: `staged_candidates/task365_offsetfuse_zeropad_cost2360/` (sha `f12c26da73d8ad2a657625cc50a07fa1faac4f95694b6195ffb763355439e9cf`). Gates: visible 266/266, truth 2000/2000, ab-vs-parent byte_equal 2266/2266, profile static=2360=profile. Fallback rung v1 = 2382 (offset-fusion only, sha `810309f7…`). **Status PROBE_READY** — `ng_safety` = WARN `WARN_X86_QUANTIZED_OP_FAMILY` (QLinearConv), *identical to the live parent's verdict* (inherited, unchanged QLinearConv); the −70 delta is all standard index tensors, so x86 cost is almost certainly 2360, but one Kaggle/own-stack probe should confirm before crediting. Builder: `prototypes/build_task365_offfuse_v2.py`.

**Remaining floor (this corner-detect structure).** Forced/verified-unavoidable: `code` F32 400 (Conv on F32 one-hot must output F32), `code_u8`+`nz` 200, `out8` BOOL 288 (8 contiguous channels for pad-to-10), `flat16` F16 128 (F16 = cheapest ORT TopK dtype; **U8/I8 TopK NOT_IMPLEMENTED, verified**), `selR`/`selC` F32 240 (Einsum must match F32 `code`; **U8 Einsum NOT_IMPLEMENTED, verified**; F16 route needs +200 cast = net-worse). A further ~−27 B exists by killing the `colgT` Transpose (asymmetric height-scalar axes) but the point gain is only +0.011 in this deep-log regime (2360→2333) at high surgery risk — **not pursued**. All genuinely-different formulations remain DEAD (band-product merges boxes; fixed-window contaminates; nearest-corner assignment fails staircase rects; flood ~5000; first-red/row-max visible-fail). Verdict: **near-floor; v2 harvested the only remaining slack.**

**MEASURED forced-component proof (2026-07-12 pass-2, #134 discipline).** Generous skeleton `prototypes/build_task365_forcedfloor_skeleton.py` = real Conv color-read + real one-hot output crop with ALL winner-detection stubbed as free initializers → profiles **1116** (mem 1070 + par 46). That is the algorithm-AGNOSTIC read+output floor: no reassembly of read+output goes below it. My v2 2360 = 1116 forced + **1244 detection** (corner-detect + extent + red-count + select). Detection alternatives measured/proven worse: **integral-image red-count = 400 B core** (2× CumSum INT32, isolated-measured) vs Einsum masks 240 B; flood ~5000; BR-corner = 2nd QLC+TopK ≥ probe; nearest-corner disproved. So sub-2360 is unreachable via any read/output reassembly or any detection algorithm found — **this is a WIN + provisional floor** (per #134, humble: a wholly unforeseen algorithm could still fall it, but the measured forced skeleton + F32-Conv/F16-TopK/F32-Einsum dtype walls bound it hard).

## Still-valid DEAD formulations (do not re-explore — cost/correctness proven)
- **Marginal band-product one-shot** — `prototypes/analyze_task365_band_product_blocker.py`: 32/266 visible, 141/266 products merge ≥2 boxes across a shared row/col marginal (generator only guarantees spacing-1 nonoverlap, so a 3rd box bridges a marginal). First official train pair product `(rows0..5,cols1..10)` merges two boxes, counts 4 reds vs true winner 3.
- **First-red / row-max seeds** — visible-fail (firstred 117/266, fixed-6×6 52/266, rowmax MatMulInteger 175/266). Exact "which box has most reds" needs real per-box red counting, not a cheap seed.
- **Nearest-corner red assignment** (new 2026-07-12) — fails for staircase-separated rects: box_A TL=(0,3) rows0-6 cols3-5, box_B TL=(2,0) rows2-4 cols0-2; point (3,4)∈A but max-top up-left corner is B's. So per-box extent IS required (Boladi's offset-probe is minimal).
- **Flood-label** ~5000+; **narrow CumSum** (int16/f16 rejected by ONNX); **U8/I8 TopK & U8 Einsum** NOT_IMPLEMENTED in ORT (verified 2026-07-12 — F16 is the cheapest working dtype for both).
